raw_segments.text: Pisanio, my lord, now fear is from me, I'll speak troth. Lord Cloten, upon my lady's
missing, came to me with his sword drawn, foamed at the mouth, and swore, if I discovered
not which way she was gone, it was my instant death.
By accident I had a feigned letter of my master's then in my pocket, which directed him to seek
her on the mountains near to Milford, where, in a frenzy, in my master's garments, which
he enforked from me, a way he posts with unchaste purpose, and with oath to violate
my lady's honor. What became of him I further know not.
